title: Slovakian Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Slovakian-inspired stew made with tender beef and vegetables.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the onions to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the paprika, beef broth, and browned beef back to the pot. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
